mapper.sql: id, chat_group_id, title, status, conclusion, closed_at, version, feature, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM topic WHERE chat_group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM topic WHERE chat_group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM topic WHERE chat_group_id = #{groupId} AND status = 'CLOSED' ORDER BY closed_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM topic WHERE status = 'CONCLUDING' AND update_time < #{threshold} ORDER BY update_time ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM topic WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND closed_at >= #{since} ORDER BY closed_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO topic (chat_group_id, title, status, conclusion, closed_at, version, feature, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{chatGroupId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{conclusion}, #{closedAt}, #{version}, #{feature, typeHandler=com.dingring.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE topic SET title = #{title}, status = #{status}, conclusion = #{conclusion}, closed_at = #{closedAt}, version = version + 1, feature = #{feature, typeHandler=com.dingring.infrastructure.persistence.typehandler.JsonMapTypeHandler}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}
